title: Perpetuating Misogyny with Generative AI: How Model Personalization Normalizes Gendered Harm

bias_targets.methodology: Inferring gender in a large dataset of generated images using the MiVOLO classifier to quantify the over-representation and higher NSFW co-occurrence rates of female subjects, analyzing metadata tags for gendered associations, and comparing image generation outputs for the neutral prompts 'woman' and 'man' across popular checkpoint models.

Estimating the ages of human subjects in generated images using the MiVOLO classifier to reveal age discrepancies, specifically highlighting the significantly younger average age and narrower age distribution of female subjects compared to male subjects.
